pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM ([A-Za-z0-9]+) INNER JOIN ([A-Za-z0-9]+) ON ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9]+) = ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.id ORDER BY .+
correction: Select only the necessary columns and remove unnecessary joins.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that unnecessarily join tables, potentially leading to incorrect results.
